title.en: Labour MP says she will trigger leadership contest by Monday if cabinet does not launch challenge – UK politics live

reflection.en: Political leadership often involves intense scrutiny and the ebb and flow of public and party support. This news reminds us that positions of power are transient, and ultimate authority rests beyond human hands. In the midst of political shifts, we are reminded that it is God who ultimately judges, bringing one down and exalting another.
reflection.zh: 政治领导力常伴随着严峻的审视以及公众和党派支持的起伏。这则新闻提醒我们，权力地位是暂时的，最终的权柄超越了人类之手。在政治变迁中，我们被提醒是雅伟最终施行审判，他使人降卑，也使人升高。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: Person killed after being hit by plane on runway at Denver airport
title.zh: 丹佛机场跑道上有人被飞机撞击身亡

summary.en: An unidentified individual died after being struck by an airliner on a runway at Denver airport. The person had reportedly jumped a perimeter fence two minutes before the incident.
summary.zh: 一名身份不明的人在丹佛机场跑道上被一架客机撞击后死亡。据报道，此人在被撞前两分钟跳过了机场围栏。

body.en:
The moment after a Frontier Airlines plane killed a person who was on a runway after jumping a perimeter fence at Denver International Airport on Friday night is captured in air traffic control audio.

"We just hit somebody," the pilot tells the control tower after halting Flight 4345's take-off. "We have an engine fire."

Smoke could be seen in the Airbus A321's cabin, but Denver Fire Department quickly extinguished the fire. All 224 passengers on board were evacuated by inflatable emergency slides as a matter of precaution, Frontier said.

"We are deeply saddened by this event," the airline added. Twelve passengers aboard the plane reported minor injuries from the incident, the airport said.

Five of the injured passengers were taken to nearby hospitals, according to airport authorities. Their conditions were unclear.

The Frontier Airlines flight was taking off for Los Angeles International Airport at around 23:00 local time (06:00 BST) when it hit the individual, authorities said.

The unnamed individual had after leapt over a perimeter fence two minutes before the impact, said the carrier.

An air traffic controller had just told the Frontier pilot they were clear for takeoff and wished them a good night.

After a short pause, the pilot called back to the tower, according to air traffic control audio.

"We're stopping on the runway," the pilot tells the tower, adding that the plane just hit someone.

The plane was moving at a "high speed" at the time, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said.

"Late last night, a trespasser breached airport security at Denver Int'l Airport, deliberately scaled a perimeter fence, and ran out onto a runway," Duffy said in a statement.

Commercial airliners typically take off at speeds between 150 and 180mph (240–290 km/h).

The trespasser is not believed to be an airport employee, Denver International Airport (DIA) said.

"The airport has examined the fenceline and found it to be intact," DIA said in a statement.

Smoke in the cabin can be seen on photos and video shared by one of the passengers.

Passenger Jose Cervantes told an affiliate of the BBC's US partner CBS that he heard a thud and then "I just see the right wing just on fire and like, it's exploding".

"I thought I was going to burn to death," he added. "You know, when I just saw the fire and the smoke, I just thought I was going to burn."

After evacuating the plane, the passengers were bused back to the terminal as emergency crews responded to the scene, DIA said.

The majority of the passengers have since left Denver on a new Frontier flight, the airport said.

The runway was closed while the Federal Aviation Administration and National Transportation Safety Board launched an investigation.

body.zh: 周五晚上，边疆航空公司的一架飞机在丹佛国际机场跳过围栏后在跑道上杀死了一名人员，空中交通管制音频记录了这一时刻。 “我们刚刚撞到了一个人，”4345 航班停止起飞后，飞行员告诉控制塔。 “我们的发动机着火了。” 空客A321的机舱内可见浓烟，但丹佛消防局很快将火扑灭。 Frontier 表示，作为预防措施，机上所有 224 名乘客均通过充气紧急滑梯疏散。 该航空公司补充说：“我们对这一事件深感悲痛。”机场称，飞机上有 12 名乘客在这起事件中受轻伤。 据机场当局称，五名受伤乘客被送往附近的医院。他们的情况尚不清楚。 当局称，当地时间 23:00 左右（英国夏令时 06:00），这架边疆航空公司的航班正起飞前往洛杉矶国际机场，撞上该人。 承运人称，这名未透露姓名的人在撞击前两分钟跳过了围栏。 一名空中交通管制员刚刚告诉边境飞行员他们可以起飞，并祝他们晚安。 根据空中交通管制音频，短暂停顿后，飞行员向塔台回电。 “我们正停在跑道上，”飞行员告诉塔台，并补充说飞机刚刚撞到了人。 交通部长肖恩·达菲表示，这架飞机当时正在“高速”飞行。 达菲在一份声明中说：“昨晚深夜，一名侵入者突破了丹佛国际机场的机场安检，故意翻越围栏，跑到跑道上。” 商用客机通常以 150 至 180 英里/小时（240-290 公里/小时）的速度起飞。 丹佛国际机场（DIA）表示，据信闯入者不是机场员工。 国防情报局在一份声明中表示：“机场已经检查了围栏线，发现它完好无损。” 从一名乘客分享的照片和视频中可以看到机舱内冒烟。 乘客何塞·塞万提斯 (Jose Cervantes) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC) 美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 的附属机构，他听到一声巨响，然后“我看到右翼着火了，就像爆炸了一样”。 “我以为我会被烧死，”他补充道。 “你知道，当我看到火焰和烟雾时，我以为我要被烧伤了。” 国防情报局表示，撤离飞机后，紧急救援人员赶赴现场，乘客被巴士送回航站楼。 机场表示，大多数乘客已搭乘新的边境航班离开丹佛。 跑道已关闭，联邦航空管理局和国家运输安全委员会展开调查。 “我们对这一事件感到非常难过，并表示......

reflection.en: This tragic incident points to the profound despair that can lead an individual to such a desperate act. In moments of overwhelming brokenness and crushed spirit, we are reminded that God is near to those who suffer deeply. May we extend compassion and seek to understand the silent struggles that can drive people to the brink.
reflection.zh: 这起悲剧事件揭示了可能导致一个人采取如此绝望行动的深切绝望。在内心极度破碎和精神受挫的时刻，我们被提醒雅伟亲近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。愿我们能施予怜悯，并努力理解那些可能将人逼到绝境的无声挣扎。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

title.en: Google developers significantly misstate carbon emissions of proposed UK datacentres
title.zh: 谷歌开发商严重低估了拟建英国数据中心的碳排放量

summary.en: Developers working for Google significantly misstated the carbon emissions of two proposed AI datacentres in the UK, understating them by a factor of five in plans for Essex and showing a similar error in Lincolnshire.
summary.zh: 为谷歌工作的开发商严重低估了其在英国拟建的两个人工智能数据中心的碳排放量，埃塞克斯郡的计划中低估了五倍，林肯郡的计划也出现了类似错误。

body.en: Emissions understated by factor of five in Essex plans for tech giant, while Greystoke’s Lincolnshire plans show similar error Developers working for Google have significantly misstated how much carbon two proposed AI datacentres will contribute to the UK’s total emissions in planning documents reviewed by the Guardian. The tech company wants to build two huge datacentres – one 52-hectare (130 acre) project in Thurrock and another at an airfield in North Weald, both in Essex. To do so, developers are required to submit planning documents calculating how much carbon these projects will emit as a proportion of the UK’s total carbon footprint. Continue reading...
body.zh: 埃塞克斯科技巨头的计划中的排放量被低估了五倍，而格雷斯托克的林肯郡计划也出现了类似的错误。在《卫报》审查的规划文件中，谷歌的开发人员明显错误地表述了两个拟议的人工智能数据中心将占英国总排放量的碳排放量。这家科技公司希望建设两个大型数据中心，一个位于瑟罗克 (Thurrock)，占地 52 公顷（130 英亩），另一个位于北威尔德 (North Weald) 的机场，两个数据中心均位于埃塞克斯。为此，开发商需要提交规划文件，计算这些项目将排放多少碳占英国总碳足迹的比例。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The integrity of data is crucial, especially when it impacts our shared environment and public trust. This report reminds us that truthfulness in all our dealings, big or small, reflects a deeper commitment to justice and accountability.
reflection.zh: 数据的完整性至关重要，尤其当它影响我们共同的环境和公众信任时。这则报道提醒我们，无论大小，所有交易中的诚实都反映了对公义和问责制的更深层承诺。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Starmer brings in Gordon Brown and Harriet Harman to ease pressure on him to resign
title.zh: 斯塔默引入戈登·布朗和哈丽特·哈曼，以缓解辞职压力

summary.en: Keir Starmer has appointed former Prime Minister Gordon Brown and veteran MP Harriet Harman as advisers. Brown will focus on global finance, while Harman will address social and economic improvements for women and girls, in a move to alleviate pressure on Starmer.
summary.zh: 基尔·斯塔默已任命前首相戈登·布朗和资深议员哈丽特·哈曼为顾问。布朗将就全球金融提供建议，而哈曼将专注于改善妇女和女童的社会经济状况，此举旨在缓解斯塔默所面临的压力。

body.en: Brown to advise on global finance, while Harman will focus on social and economic improvements for women and girls UK politics live – latest updates Full results from England, Scotland and Wales Keir Starmer has brought in Gordon Brown and Harriet Harman as advisers in a move to ease the mounting pressure on the prime minister to resign after the disastrous election results for Labour. Brown, the former prime minister and long-serving chancellor under Tony Blair, has been made Starmer’s envoy on global finance, with a brief to advise on financial partnerships to help with defence-related investments, particularly with Europe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 布朗将就全球金融提供建议，而哈曼将专注于妇女和女孩的社会和经济改善 英国政治现场 - 最新动态 英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士的完整结果凯尔·斯塔默聘请戈登·布朗和哈里特·哈曼担任顾问，此举旨在缓解工党灾难性选举结果后首相面临的日益严峻的辞职压力。前首相、托尼·布莱尔领导下长期任职的财政大臣布朗已被任命为斯塔默的全球金融特使，其职责是就金融伙伴关系提供建议，以帮助国防相关投资，特别是与欧洲的投资。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights a leader seeking diverse counsel during a time of pressure. Proverbs reminds us that wise leadership often depends not on one person's sole understanding, but on the strength found in a multitude of advisors. Such collaboration can bring stability and fresh perspectives when facing complex challenges.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻讲述了一位领袖在压力之下寻求多方建议。箴言提醒我们，明智的领导力往往不依赖于个人独断，而在于从众多谋士中汲取力量。这种协作能在面对复杂挑战时带来稳定和新的视角。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: I will serve - not rule over Hungary, says new PM
title.zh: 匈牙利新总理将在“政权更迭”派对中宣誓就职

summary.en: Nearly a month ago Péter Magyar steered his Tisza party to a landslide victory in Hungary, sweeping away 16 years of rule by Viktor Orbán. Magyar is now set to be sworn in as the new Prime Minister, marking a significant political shift in the country.
summary.zh: 近一个月前，彼得·马扎尔领导的蒂萨党在匈牙利大选中取得压倒性胜利，结束了维克托·欧尔班长达16年的执政。马扎尔即将宣誓就任新总理，标志着该国政治格局的重大转变。

body.en:
Hungary's new prime minister, Péter Magyar, has been sworn in, almost a month after he steered his Tisza party to a landslide victory, sweeping away 16 years of rule by Viktor Orbán.

"I will not rule over Hungary - I will serve my country," Magyar said after he took the oath of office in parliament.

Tisza holds 141 seats out of 199 in the new parliament - up from zero, a result of the party being founded just two years ago.

Tens of thousands of people are expected to take part in a "celebration of freedom and democracy" outside parliament in Budapest, along the shores of the Danube. Magyar has told Hungarians to step through the "gateway of regime change".

Orbán's Fidesz party crumbled from 135 to 52 seats, and shows signs of imploding.

He and other key party figures have decided not to take their seats in parliament , and their political future is uncertain, beyond a vague commitment to "rebuild the national side".

Each day brings new revelations or allegations of corruption against a party which has governed Hungary almost unchallenged since 2010. Magyar has promised a "change of system" as well as a change of government.

"The main priority is to set up the government... on the ruins of the previous one," Zoltán Tarr, incoming Minister for Social Relations and Culture, told the BBC.

"We are ready to face a very grim economic situation. But at the moment, we just don't know the severity."

A spending spree initiated by the Orbán government in the past eight months came on top of years in which state contracts and funds were channelled to business circles close to Fidesz.

The budget deficit has already swollen close to the planned target for the whole year.

The incoming government is at pains to show that it is morally stronger than Fidesz.

One prominent businessman, György Wáberer, who switched from Fidesz to Tisza a week before the election, told a journalist he had donated £242,000 (€280,000, $331,000) to Tisza.

When Magyar's brother-in-law, Márton Melléthei-Barna, was named justice minister, the new government was bitterly criticised on social media.

On Thursday evening, Melléthei-Barna announced that he was withdrawing his candidacy for the post, "to ensure that not even the slightest shadow is cast on the transition".

Incoming Tisza ministers say there will be no revenge against the outgoing government, but those guilty of financial crimes will be held accountable. A new "office to recover stolen assets" will be set up.

"I don't think that we should talk about a guillotine," said Tarr, in response to calls for those responsible for siphoning off the national wealth to go on trial.

"We are talking about investigations and actions which are totally in line with the rule of law. Interestingly enough, the current chief prosecutor,...
body.zh: 匈牙利新任总理彼得·马扎尔 (Péter Magyar) 即将宣誓就职，距离他带领蒂萨党取得压倒性胜利、推翻欧尔班·维克托 (Viktor Orbán) 16 年的统治近一个月。 蒂萨在新议会的 199 个席位中占有 141 个席位，而该党成立于两年前，席位从零增加到了 141 个。 计划于周六在多瑙河沿岸的布达佩斯议会前举行大型“自由和民主庆祝活动”。马扎尔告诉匈牙利人要跨过“政权更迭的大门”。 欧尔班的青民盟政党从 135 个席位减少到 52 个，并显示出崩溃的迹象。 他和其他党内关键人物已决定不在议会中占据席位，除了“重建国家方面”的模糊承诺之外，他们的政治前途也充满不确定性。 每天都会有新的揭露或指控针对一个自 2010 年以来几乎没有受到挑战地统治匈牙利的政党。马扎尔承诺“改变制度”并更换政府。 目前尚不清楚欧尔班是否会出席周六的议会开幕会议，哪怕只是作为一个简单的嘉宾。 即将上任的社会关系和文化部长佐尔坦·塔尔告诉英国广播公司：“首要任务是在上届政府的废墟上建立新政府。” “我们已经准备好面对非常严峻的经济形势。但目前，我们只是不知道其严重性。” 过去八个月里，欧尔班政府发起了一场支出热潮，此前几年，国家合同和资金都流向了青民盟附近的商界。 预算赤字已经接近全年计划目标。 即将上任的政府煞费苦心地表明，它在道德上比青民盟更强大。 一位著名商人 György Wáberer 在选举前一周从青民盟转向蒂萨，他告诉记者，他已向蒂萨捐赠了 242,000 英镑（280,000 欧元，331,000 美元）。 当马扎尔的姐夫马顿·梅勒泰-巴尔纳被任命为司法部长时，新政府在社交媒体上遭到了严厉批评。 周四晚上，梅勒泰-巴纳宣布退出该职位的候选人资格，“以确保过渡不会蒙上丝毫阴影”。 即将上任的蒂萨部长表示，不会对即将卸任的政府进行报复，但那些犯有金融犯罪的人将被追究责任。将设立一个新的“追回被盗资产办公室”。 “我认为我们不应该谈论断头台，”塔尔在回应要求对那些吸走国家财富的责任人进行审判的呼吁时说道。 “我们正在谈论完全符合法治的调查和行动。有趣的是，现任首席检察官和警方已经开始......

reflection.en: This news of a significant political shift reminds us that power dynamics are always in flux. Psalm 75:7 offers a profound perspective, asserting that it is God who ultimately judges, bringing one down and exalting another. Such transitions invite us to reflect on the transient nature of human authority and the enduring sovereignty of a higher power.
reflection.zh: 这则关于重大政治变迁的新闻提醒我们，权力格局总是在不断变化。诗篇75:7提供了一个深刻的视角，它宣告是雅伟最终审判，使一人降卑，使另一人升高。这样的过渡促使我们反思人类权力的短暂性，以及更高权柄的永恒主权。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: Two men charged over alleged filming of antisemitic TikTok videos in London
title.zh: 两名男子因涉嫌在伦敦拍摄反犹太TikTok视频被起诉

summary.en: Two men, Adam Bedoui, 20, and Abdelkader Amir Bousloub, 21, have been charged with religiously aggravated harassment. The charges stem from allegations that they traveled to north London to film antisemitic TikTok videos.
summary.zh: 20岁的亚当·贝杜伊和21岁的阿卜杜勒卡德尔·阿米尔·布斯卢布被控犯有加重宗教仇恨的骚扰罪。这些指控源于他们前往伦敦北部拍摄反犹太TikTok视频的指控。

body.en: Adam Bedoui, 20, and Abdelkader Amir Bousloub, 21, charged with religiously aggravated harassment Two men have been charged with religiously aggravated harassment over allegations they travelled to north London to film antisemitic TikTok videos. Officers were called to reports of a hate crime involving a group of men allegedly harassing members of the Jewish community on Clapton Common at about 9pm on Thursday, the Metropolitan police said. Officers arrested five men in Hackney after the incident, it added. Continue reading...
body.zh: 20 岁的 Adam Bedoui 和 21 岁的 Abdelkader Amir Bousloub 被指控犯有严重宗教骚扰罪 两名男子因前往伦敦北部拍摄反犹太主义 TikTok 视频而被指控犯有严重宗教骚扰罪。大都会警方称，周四晚上 9 点左右，警方接到报告称，一群男子涉嫌在克莱普顿公地骚扰犹太社区成员，发生仇恨犯罪。事件发生后，警方在哈克尼逮捕了五名男子。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, capable of both deep harm and profound healing. This incident reminds us how reckless speech, especially when fueled by prejudice, can wound communities and violate the peace we are called to uphold. May we seek to use our voices to build up rather than tear down, bringing healing instead of harm.
reflection.zh: 言语蕴含着巨大的力量，既能造成深远的伤害，也能带来深刻的医治。这起事件提醒我们，鲁莽的言论，尤其是当它被偏见所煽动时，会伤害社群并破坏我们被呼召去维护的和平。愿我们寻求用我们的声音去建造而非拆毁，带来医治而非伤害。

verse.textEn: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
verse.textZh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。

title.en: Australia's right-wing One Nation party scores historic parliamentary win
title.zh: 澳大利亚右翼一国党取得历史性议会胜利

summary.en: One Nation gains its first seat in the lower house, in a by-election seen as a key test for the populist party.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Australia's One Nation party has won its first-ever lower-house seat in what is being seen as an important test for the right-wing populist party.

With most ballots counted, One-Nation candidate David Farley has won an unassailable 60% of the primary vote in Farrer, a vast regional constituency in New South Wales. Independent candidate Michelle Milthorpe is far behind.

The contest was triggered by the resignation of Sussan Ley, who quit when she was ousted as leader of the opposition conservative Liberal Party.

While the result will not affect the Labor government's large majority, it is a clear sign that voters are moving away from traditional political parties in Australia.

Saturday's poll was the first federal test of One Nation's support after the party recorded the second-highest number of votes out of any political party in the South Australian state election in March.

As news of the party's victory emerged, One Nation leader Pauline Hanson told supporters this was not just a win for Farrer, but a win for Australia, and said the party was "coming after those other seats".

Farley - whose background is in agribusiness - told supporters One Nation had "reached the end of its beginning, we're going through the ceiling".

"What are we doing tonight? We're like a mason, with a chisel, and a hammer and we're re-carving the letters into the Australian democracy."

Australia has a preferential voting system where voters rank candidates from their most to least preferred. The final tally is calculated as a challenge between two candidates after preferences are distributed to ensure that the winner is supported by a majority.

One Nation had never won a federal lower house contest before Saturday's poll. In the late 1990s Hanson initially held her seat as an independent before losing her re-election bid. She has since returned to the parliament as a senator.

During the campaign, Farley said he had "lost a bit of faith" in the major parties. "They say one thing to your face and then go and do something else in parliament," he said.

Farrer spans 127,000 sq km (49,000 sq miles), an area larger than South Korea, and takes in the regional centres of Albury, Griffith and Deniliquin. The seat has always been held by either the Liberal or National parties.

The by-election also marked tests for the new leaders of the Liberal and National parties, respectively Angus Taylor, who ousted Ley in February , and Matt Canavan, who replaced David Littleproud in March.

The Liberal-National coalition suffered its worst ever defeat in last year's federal election, and the two parties have struggled with infighting and poor polling since then.
body.zh: 澳大利亚一国党赢得了有史以来第一个下议院席位，这被视为对右翼民粹主义政党的重要考验。 随着大部分选票的清点，一国党候选人戴维·法利 (David Farley) 在新南威尔士州广大地区选区法雷尔 (Farrer) 赢得了无可争议的 60% 初选选票。独立候选人米歇尔·米尔索普远远落后。 此次竞选是由苏珊·莱伊 (Sussan Ley) 辞职引发的，她在反对派保守派自由党领袖职位上被赶下台后辞职。 虽然结果不会影响工党政府的绝大多数席位，但这是一个明显的迹象，表明选民正在远离澳大利亚的传统政党。 周六的民意调查是联邦对一国党支持率的首次测试，此前该党在三月份的南澳大利亚州选举中获得了所有政党中第二高的票数。 随着该党获胜的消息传出，一国党领导人宝琳·汉森告诉支持者，这不仅是法雷尔的胜利，也是澳大利亚的胜利，并表示该党“正在追赶其他席位”。 拥有农业企业背景的法利告诉支持者，一国党“已经走到了起点的尽头，我们正在突破天花板”。 “今晚我们要做什么？我们就像泥瓦匠，拿着凿子和锤子，将这些字母重新雕刻成澳大利亚的民主。” 澳大利亚有一个优先投票制度，选民按照最喜欢到最不喜欢的顺序对候选人进行排名。最终计票结果是在分配偏好后，作为两名候选人之间的挑战来计算的，以确保获胜者得到多数人的支持。 在周六的民意调查之前，一国党从未赢得过联邦下议院竞选。 20 世纪 90 年代末，汉森最初以独立人士身份保住自己的席位，但在连任竞选中失败。此后她以参议员的身份重返议会。 在竞选期间，法利表示他对主要政党“失去了一点信心”。 “他们当面说一件事，然后在议会里做另一件事，”他说。 法雷尔占地 127,000 平方公里（49,000 平方英里），面积比韩国还大，包括奥尔伯里、格里菲斯和德尼利昆的区域中心。该席位一直由自由党或国家党占据。 这次补选也标志着自由党和国家党新任领导人的考验，分别是二月份罢免莱伊的安格斯·泰勒(Angus Taylor)和三月份取代大卫·利特尔普劳德(David Littleproud)的马特·卡纳万(Matt Canavan)。 自由党-国家党联盟在去年的联邦选举中遭受了有史以来最惨重的失败，此后两党一直在内讧和糟糕的民意调查中挣扎。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to leadership, wisdom, and public responsibility. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with wisdom, integrity, and service, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到领导、智慧与公共责任。Proverbs 11:14提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以智慧、正直与服事来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: WHO chief reassures Tenerife residents ahead of arrival of virus-hit cruise ship
title.zh: 世卫组织总干事在受病毒袭击的游轮抵达之前向特内里费岛居民保证

summary.en: "This is not another Covid," Tedros Ghebreyesus tells islanders before MV Hondius docks on Sunday.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The director general of the World Health Organization (WHO) has sought to reassure residents of Tenerife that their risk of infection is low ahead of the arrival of a cruise ship on which an outbreak of hantavirus occurred.

Tedros Ghebreyesus stressed that "this is not another Covid" and that there were no symptomatic passengers currently aboard the MV Hondius, in a personal message to people on the Canary Island.

The MV Hondius is due to arrive in the port of Granadilla in the early hours of Sunday morning, sparking concern among locals.

Six cases have been confirmed among the ship's passengers, including in one of the three who died while the Dutch vessel was sailing from South America.

Spanish officials have sought to allay concerns about the ship's arrival, laying out in detail the containment precautions being taken.

Hantaviruses are usually carried by rodents, but human transmission of the Andes strain - which the WHO believes was contracted by some of the ship's passengers while in South America - is possible.

Symptoms can include fever, extreme fatigue, muscle aches, stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhoea and shortness of breath.

"I know that when you hear the word 'outbreak' and watch a ship sail toward your shores, memories surface that none of us have fully put to rest. The pain of 2020 is still real, and I do not dismiss it for a single moment.

"But I need you to hear me clearly: this is not another Covid. The current public health risk from hantavirus remains low."

He added that there was currently a WHO expert, Dr Freddy Banza-Mutoka, aboard the MV Hondius.

Along with two Dutch physicians, he is conducting medical and exposure assessments of everyone on the vessel, the WHO said, and is currently reporting that no more passengers are showing symptoms of hantavirus.

Ghebreyesus has travelled to Tenerife to observe the forthcoming operation first-hand, the international agency said.

The ship is expected to drop anchor in the Canary Islands sometime between 04:00-06:00 GMT on Sunday, Spanish Health Minister Mónica García said on Saturday.

Its passengers will be held on the boat and will only be able to leave on smaller boats when there is a repatriation flight waiting for them on the tarmac, she told a news conference.

Flights are planned to take them back to the UK, the US, France, Germany, Belgium and Ireland, officials have said. The EU is sending a further two planes for the remaining European citizens.

The MV Hondius's arrival comes against the wishes of the region's president Fernando Clavijo, who questioned why the final phase of the response to the outbreak could not have taken place in Cape Verde, its previous stopping point.

body.zh: 在一艘爆发汉坦病毒的游轮抵达之前，世界卫生组织（WHO）总干事试图向特内里费岛居民保证，他们感染的风险很低。 谭德塞在给加那利群岛人民的个人信息中强调，“这不是另一场新冠病毒”，MV Hondius 号上目前没有出现症状的乘客。 MV Hondius 将于周日凌晨抵达格拉纳迪拉港，引发当地人的担忧。 船上乘客中已确诊六例病例，其中三人是在这艘荷兰船从南美航行时死亡的。 西班牙官员试图减轻人们对这艘船抵达的担忧，详细列出了正在采取的遏制预防措施。 汉坦病毒通常由啮齿类动物携带，但安第斯病毒株也可能在人类中传播——世界卫生组织认为该病毒是由船上的一些乘客在南美期间感染的。 症状包括发烧、极度疲劳、肌肉酸痛、胃痛、呕吐、腹泻和呼吸急促。 “我知道，当你听到‘疫情’这个词，看着一艘船驶向你的海岸时，我们所有人都还没有完全平息的记忆浮现出来。2020年的痛苦仍然是真实的，我一刻也不会忽视它。 “但我需要你听清楚：这不是另一个新冠病毒。目前汉坦病毒的公共卫生风险仍然很低。” 他补充说，目前 MV Hondius 上有一名世卫组织专家 Freddy Banza-Mutoka 博士。 世界卫生组织表示，他正在与两名荷兰医生一起对船上的每个人进行医疗和暴露评估，目前报告称没有更多乘客出现汉坦病毒症状。 该国际机构表示，盖布雷耶苏斯已前往特内里费岛亲眼观察即将进行的行动。 西班牙卫生部长莫妮卡·加西亚周六表示，该船预计将于格林尼治标准时间周日 04:00-06:00 在加那利群岛抛锚。 她在新闻发布会上说，乘客将被留在船上，只有当停机坪上有遣返航班等待他们时，才能乘坐较小的船只离开。 官员们表示，计划用航班将他们带回英国、美国、法国、德国、比利时和爱尔兰。欧盟正在为剩余的欧洲公民再派遣两架飞机。 MV Hondius 号的抵达违背了该地区总统费尔南多·克拉维霍 (Fernando Clavijo) 的意愿，后者质疑为何不能在之前的停靠点佛得角进行最后阶段的疫情应对。 这引发了当地的抗议活动以及极右翼分子对中央政府的攻击……

title.en: Tariffs or not? How EU is dealing with US 'dealmaking'
title.zh: 关税与否？欧盟如何应对美国的“交易策略”

summary.en: President Trump earlier this week threatened European car makers with 25% tariffs before walking it back later in the week. The European Union is now navigating the challenges posed by this unpredictable approach to international trade relations.
summary.zh: 美国总统特朗普本周早些时候曾威胁对欧洲汽车制造商征收25%的关税，但随后又撤回了这一威胁。欧盟目前正在应对这种不可预测的国际贸易关系方式所带来的挑战。

body.en:
Earlier this week, President Trump threatened European car makers with 25% tariffs before walking it back later in the week. How is the EU dealing with this unpredictability?

When the trade ministers of the so-called Group of Seven, or G7, nations met in Paris this week, they were supposed to be talking about the most pressing issues facing global trade, including critical minerals and the impact of the Iran war.

Instead, the meeting was overshadowed by threats made by US President Donald Trump to impose a 25% tariff on imports of European vehicles.

Trump made the threats earlier this week and has justified them by arguing that the European Union — members France, Germany and Italy also belong to the G7 — hasn't fulfilled its obligations under a previous US-EU tariff deal known as the Turnberry Agreement.

The deal was struck at Trump's Turnberry golf course in Scotland and both sides agreed the US would only impose a maximum tariff of 15% on EU goods, while the EU would eliminate all tariffs on US industrial products. The Europeans reject the idea that they haven't kept up their end of the bargain, although they have yet to ratify the agreement in the European Parliament.

Before the G7 summit, the EU Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security, Maros Sefcovic, spoke with US Trade Representative, Jamieson Greer, in Paris.

Sefcovic later said that he and Greer had "clearly concluded that it's important to respect the deal from Turnberry from both sides."

That means that the EU must reduce tariffs on US exports as agreed and the US should return to the promised 15% tariff, Sefcovic said.

Katherina Reiche, Germany's minister for economic affairs and energy, also spoke with her American counterparts in Paris.

"It is true we are making progress in implementing the compromise we reached on a tariff agreement," Reiche told DW. She added that the issue of auto exports is a central one for Germany that she hoped would be resolved via ongoing talks.

In fact, on Friday, Trump did pull back somewhat on the threat of 25% tariffs. He said he would be prepared to wait until July 4 to decide whether to impose higher tariffs on the EU.

After a phone call with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, Trump said he agreed to give her until "our Country's 250th Birthday or, unfortunately, their Tariffs would immediately jump to much higher levels," the BBC reported.

Complicating matters further is the fact that just hours before Trump agreed to wait until July 4, a US court ruled against other Trump tariffs , which would open the door for further legal pushback.

Should higher tariffs actually be implemented, the German car industry would be particularly hard hit, an analysis by the Kiel Institute for the World Economy found.

reflection.en: International relations often involve navigating unpredictable actions and shifting policies from other parties. In such times, the biblical call to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, offers a guiding principle. It encourages a steady commitment to diplomacy and stability, even when faced with volatility.
reflection.zh: 国际关系常涉及应对其他方不可预测的行动和变化的政策。在这样的时刻，圣经呼吁我们，若能行，总要尽力与众人和睦，这提供了一个指导原则。它鼓励我们即使面对动荡，也要坚定地致力于外交和稳定。

title.en: Eurovision 2026: Politics collide with a blockbuster show
title.zh: 2026年欧洲歌唱大赛：政治与盛大演出发生冲突

summary.en: The Eurovision Song Contest is facing significant controversy and unprecedented boycotts due to Israel's participation, even before the event begins in Vienna.
summary.zh: 欧洲歌唱大赛在维也纳开幕前，就因以色列的参与而面临巨大争议和前所未有的抵制。

body.zh: 甚至在欧洲歌唱大赛在维也纳拉开帷幕之前，有关以色列参与的争议和规模空前的抵制就已经给欧洲歌唱大赛带来了压力。 2026 年维也纳欧洲歌唱大赛尚未开始，但几个月来它一直是激烈争论的焦点。问题不在于壮观的流行表现，而在于政治紧张局势，尽管这项赛事长期以来一直声称其与政治无关，但这种紧张局势正变得越来越难以忽视。 奥地利首都上一次举办欧洲歌唱大赛是在 2015 年。今年，在其成立 70 周年之际，比赛将于 5 月 12 日至 16 日重返这座代表文化和多样性的城市。 人们的期望很高，因为比赛旨在将人们聚集在一起并传递开放的信息。座右铭是“音乐团结——（在）欧洲的心脏” 但这正是逐年变得越来越困难的挑战，因为一些参与国的政治危机也在加剧。 与往年一样，以色列再次成为人们关注的焦点。在加沙持续不断的冲突中，活动人士和一些创意界成员再次呼吁将该国排除在外或抵制。 最近，超过 1,100 名艺术家签署了一封公开信，明确表示：只要以色列参加，就不会参加欧洲歌唱大赛。 “种族灭绝不听音乐”倡议的支持者包括彼得·加布里埃尔、Massive Attack、罗杰·沃特斯、麦克莫尔和布莱恩·伊诺等国际明星。 另一方面，亲以色列倡议“和平创意社区”的一封公开信也得到了大约 1,100 名娱乐界人士的签名，其中包括海伦·米伦、艾米·舒默和吉恩·西蒙斯。它主张以色列参与：“我们感到震惊和失望的是，娱乐业的一些成员呼吁将以色列排除在比赛之外，因为以色列对大屠杀以来最大规模的犹太人屠杀做出了反应，”信中写道。 维也纳警方预计会出现破坏性抗议活动，并试图阻止活动，尤其是在最后一天。他们宣布，预计 5 月 16 日将有约 3,000 名亲巴勒斯坦团体参加示威。不过，预计还会采取进一步行动。示威者也可能来自国外。 然而，以色列派遣歌手诺姆·贝坦 (Noam Bettan) 前往维也纳，演唱看似普通的令人心碎的流行音乐……

reflection.zh: 像欧洲歌唱大赛这样的文化活动，本意是汇聚人心，却常成为深刻政治分歧的舞台。当国家和群体优先考虑自身议程或自以为是的正义时，这可能会掩盖共同的体验。腓立比书2:3提醒我们，要存谦卑的心，看别人比自己强，这是处理此类复杂全球紧张局势的有力原则。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: A 'super-hot' orb, flying discs and the Eye of Sauron: What's in the just-released UFO files?
title.zh: 一个“超热”光球、飞碟和索伦之眼：刚刚公布的UFO文件里有什么？

summary.en: US President Donald Trump ordered the release of UFO files, including descriptions of 'super-hot' orbs and flying discs. The President stated his intention was for people to 'decide for themselves, "WHAT THE HELL IS GOING ON?"'
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普下令公布UFO文件，其中包括对“超热”光球和飞碟的描述。总统表示，此举是为了让人们“自己决定，‘到底发生了什么？’”

body.en:
One report from a US military command described an unidentified anomalous phenomena that resembled a "football-shaped body" near Japan. Credit: US Department of Defence

United States President Donald Trump has released a tranche of declassified files on alleged UFO sightings and extraterrestrial life dating as far back as the 1940s, in what he is calling an effort to provide "maximum transparency" to the public.

Sightings of flying saucers, discs and a "super-hot" hovering orb, as well as an encounter with a Lord of the Rings-style glowing orange light, are among the reported incidents in the FBI, State Department, NASA and Pentagon files.

The more than 160 newly released files cover incidents that, for a range of reasons, couldn't be conclusively explained by these organisations.

Additional documents will be released as more materials are declassified, the Pentagon said.

Interest in UFOs has intensified in recent years, after the US government investigated numerous reports of unusual aircraft, amid concerns foreign adversaries could be trialling highly advanced technologies.

Though the Pentagon has been working on declassifying the documents for years, Trump drove fresh curiosity earlier this year when he teased that a major UFO and alien document dump was forthcoming.

He made the promise days after former president Barack Obama went viral for suggesting aliens are "real" during a podcast appearance.

The Pentagon described the files as new and "never-before-seen", though some had been made public years ago.

Trump wrote in a Truth Social post on Saturday that he had directed his administration to release the files "in an effort for complete and maximum transparency".

"Whereas previous Administrations have failed to be transparent on this subject, with these new Documents and Videos, the people can decide for themselves, "WHAT THE HELL IS GOING ON?" Have Fun and Enjoy!" Trump wrote.

Experts have urged people to avoid jumping to conclusions when reading the files, warning that videos of unidentified anomalous phenomena, or UAPs, are frequently misinterpreted by those unfamiliar with military technology.

No verified evidence of intelligent life beyond Earth has ever been produced, and the Pentagon said in a 2024 report it had no proof that UAPs were alien technology, with many suspicious sightings turning out to be normal aircraft.

Another shows what is described as "unidentified phenomena" taken from the surface of the moon during the 1969 Apollo 12 mission.

There's also a transcript from NASA's 1972 Apollo 17 mission in which pilot Ronald Evans reports seeing "a few very bright particles or fragments or something that go drifting by" from the moon.

reflection.en: When faced with unusual or unexplained phenomena, it's natural to seek understanding and form our own conclusions. Proverbs 14:15 reminds us that while the naive may believe everything, the prudent take time to consider and discern. This encourages thoughtful reflection rather than hasty judgment when encountering the unknown.
reflection.zh: 面对不寻常或无法解释的现象时，人们自然会寻求理解并形成自己的结论。箴言14:15提醒我们，愚蒙人凡事都信，但通达人却会思想自己的脚步。这鼓励我们在面对未知时，要深思熟虑而非仓促作判断。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure' after empty oil tankers struck
title.zh: 伊朗指责美国在袭击空油轮后进行“鲁莽的军事冒险”

summary.en: The US military reported striking empty oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, claiming the vessels attempted to breach a blockade on Iranian ports. Iran condemned the action, labeling it a "reckless military adventure."
summary.zh: 美国军方称，在霍尔木兹海峡袭击了试图突破对伊朗港口封锁的空油轮。伊朗谴责此举为“鲁莽的军事冒险”。

body.en:
The US has imposed a blockade on Iranian ports since peace talks collapsed last month. Source: Getty / US Navy

The United States military has fired on and disabled two Iranian oil tankers after exchanging fire with Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz.

The United Arab Emirates, meanwhile, reported another Iranian missile and drone attack.

The attacks cast more doubt on a tenuous month-old ceasefire that the US has insisted is still in effect . The US is awaiting an Iranian response to its latest proposal for a deal to end the war, reopen the strait and roll back Iran's disputed nuclear program.

Iran's foreign ministry condemned what it called "hostile" US military action, saying it violated the ceasefire.

"Every time a diplomatic solution is on the table, the U.S. opts for a reckless military adventure," Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi posted on X.

The US military said on Friday local time that its forces had disabled two Iranian tankers that were trying to breach a US blockade of Iran's ports. Hours earlier, the military said it thwarted attacks on three Navy ships and struck Iranian military facilities in the strait.

Iran has mostly blocked the critical waterway for global energy since the US and Israel launched the war on 28 February, causing a global spike in fuel prices and rattling world markets. The US has imposed its own blockade of Iran's ports.

The US military posted video of the two Iranian tankers as their smokestacks were struck by an American fighter jet on Friday. Earlier in the week, an American military jet shot out the rudder of a tanker the US military said was attempting to breach its blockade.

Late Thursday, the US military said it thwarted Iranian attacks on three Navy ships in the Strait of Hormuz and struck Iranian military facilities in response. It said no American ships were hit.

It comes as US secretary of state Marco Rubio said he hopes to receive "a serious offer" of peace from Iran.

"They threaten Americans, they are going to be blown up," Rubio told reporters on Friday.

US President Donald Trump has insisted the ceasefire is holding. He also has reiterated threats to resume full-scale bombing if Iran doesn't accept an agreement to reopen the strait and roll back its nuclear program.

The UAE's defence ministry, meanwhile, said three people were wounded after air defences engaged two ballistic missiles and three drones launched by Iran. It was not clear if all were successfully intercepted.

body.zh: 上个月和谈破裂后，美国对伊朗港口实施封锁。资料来源：盖蒂/美国海军 在霍尔木兹海峡与伊朗军队交火后，美国军方向两艘伊朗油轮开火并使其瘫痪。 与此同时，阿拉伯联合酋长国报告了另一起伊朗导弹和无人机袭击事件。 这些袭击事件让人们对为期一个月的脆弱停火协议产生了更多疑问，而美国坚称该停火协议仍然有效。美国正在等待伊朗对其最新提议作出回应，该提议旨在结束战争、重新开放海峡并削减伊朗有争议的核计划。 伊朗外交部谴责美国的“敌对”军事行动，称其违反了停火协议。 伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇 (Abbas Araghchi) 在 X 上发帖称：“每次外交解决方案摆在桌面上时，美国都会选择鲁莽的军事冒险。” 美国军方于当地时间周五表示，其部队已使两艘试图突破美国对伊朗港口封锁的伊朗油轮瘫痪。几个小时前，军方表示挫败了对三艘海军舰艇的袭击，并袭击了伊朗在该海峡的军事设施。 自2月28日美国和以色列发动战争以来，伊朗基本上封锁了全球能源的关键航道，导致全球燃料价格飙升，扰乱了世界市场。美国也对伊朗港口实施了封锁。 周五，美国军方发布了两艘伊朗油轮烟囱被一架美国战斗机击中的视频。本周早些时候，一架美国军用飞机击飞了一艘油轮的方向舵，美国军方称这艘油轮正试图突破封锁。 周四晚些时候，美国军方表示，它挫败了伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡三艘海军舰艇的袭击，并袭击了伊朗的军事设施作为回应。据称没有美国船只被击中。 与此同时，美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥表示，他希望收到伊朗提出的“认真的和平提议”。 卢比奥周五对记者说：“他们威胁美国人，他们将被炸毁。” 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普坚称停火仍在继续。他还重申，如果伊朗不接受重新开放海峡并削减其核计划的协议，他将恢复全面轰炸。 与此同时，阿联酋国防部表示，防空系统击中了伊朗发射的两枚弹道导弹和三架无人机，造成三人受伤。目前尚不清楚是否全部都被成功拦截。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In moments of international tension, the use of force, even in perceived defense, carries the grave risk of escalation. Jesus' words remind us of the perilous cycle that can begin when the sword is drawn, often leading to unintended and tragic consequences for all involved. May leaders seek paths that prioritize de-escalation and peaceful resolution.
reflection.zh: 在国际局势紧张之时，即使是出于自卫的武力使用，也蕴藏着局势升级的严重风险。耶稣的话语提醒我们，一旦拔剑，就可能开启危险的循环，常常给所有卷入者带来意想不到的悲剧性后果。愿领袖们寻求优先考虑缓和局势与和平解决的道路。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Russia and Ukraine agree to renewed three-day ceasefire and prisoner swap, Trump says
title.zh: 特朗普表示，俄罗斯和乌克兰同意延长三天停火和囚犯交换

summary.en: The US president said the halt in fighting for Victory Day celebrations could mark the "beginning of the end" of the war.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump said he made his request for the ceasefire "directly" to the presidents of Russia and Ukraine. Source: Getty / Aaron Schwartz

United States President Donald Trump says Russia and Ukraine have agreed to his request for a three-day ceasefire and an exchange of prisoners, adding that such a halt to hostilities could be the "beginning of the end" of the long war between them.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Yuri Ushakov, Russian President Vladimir Putin's foreign affairs adviser, both confirmed the agreement.

"I asked and, President Putin agreed, President Zelenskyy agreed — both readily," Trump said as he departed the White House on Friday, local time.

"And we have a little period of time where they’re not going to be killing people. That’s very good."

Trump earlier had announced on social media that the ceasefire would run from Saturday through Monday. Saturday is Victory Day in Russia, a holiday that commemorates the victory over Nazi Germany in World War II.

"I am pleased to announce that there will be a THREE DAY CEASEFIRE (May 9th, 10th, and 11th) in the War between Russia and Ukraine," Trump wrote.

"The Celebration in Russia is for Victory Day but, likewise, in Ukraine, because they were also a big part and factor of World War II."

The US president said the ceasefire includes a suspension of all kinetic activity and the exchange of 1,000 prisoners by each country.

Russia had announced a ceasefire for Friday and Saturday, but it quickly unravelled, with both sides blaming the other for the continued fighting , just as they had when Ukraine's own unilateral ceasefire had swiftly collapsed earlier in the week.

Trump said he made his request for the ceasefire "directly" to the two presidents.

"Hopefully, it is the beginning of the end of a very long, deadly, and hard-fought war," he said.

Trump added that talks continue over ending the war that began in February 2022 "and we are getting closer and closer every day".

Trump has gone back and forth over whether the war will end, at times expressing optimism and at other times saying Russia and Ukraine should be left to fight it out to the bitter end.

Zelenskyy said Ukraine’s decision on how to engage with those discussions was shaped in part by the prospect of freeing its prisoners. Ukraine has made the return of prisoners of war a central demand throughout the conflict.

"Red Square matters less to us than the lives of Ukrainian prisoners of war who can be brought home," Zelenskyy wrote on Telegram.

Red Square is where Russia holds its traditional military parade to celebrate Victory Day, one of the biggest holidays of the year.

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他“直接”向俄罗斯和乌克兰总统提出停火请求。资料来源：盖蒂/亚伦·施瓦茨 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意他提出的为期三天停火和交换囚犯的要求，并补充说，这种敌对行动的停止可能是两国之间长期战争“结束的开始”。 乌克兰总统泽连斯基和俄罗斯总统普京的外交事务顾问尤里·乌沙科夫均确认了该协议。 “我提出了要求，普京总统同意了，泽伦斯基总统也同意了——两者都很乐意，”特朗普于当地时间周五离开白宫时说道。 “而且我们有一段时间他们不会杀人。这非常好。” 特朗普早些时候在社交媒体上宣布停火将从周六持续到周一。周六是俄罗斯的胜利日，这是一个纪念二战中战胜纳粹德国的节日。 特朗普写道：“我很高兴地宣布，俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争将停火三天（5月9日、10日和11日）。” “俄罗斯的庆祝活动是为了庆祝胜利日，但乌克兰也是如此，因为他们也是第二次世界大战的重要组成部分和因素。” 美国总统表示，停火包括暂停所有军事活动以及两国交换 1000 名囚犯。 俄罗斯曾宣布周五和周六停火，但很快就破裂了，双方都指责对方造成了持续的战斗，就像本周早些时候乌克兰单方面停火迅速破裂时一样。 特朗普表示，他“直接”向两国总统提出停火请求。 他说：“希望这是一场漫长、致命和艰苦的战争结束的开始。” 特朗普补充说，关于结束 2022 年 2 月开始的战争的谈判仍在继续，“我们每天都越来越接近”。 特朗普在战争是否会结束的问题上来来回回，有时表示乐观，有时则表示应该让俄罗斯和乌克兰决一死战。 泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰决定如何参与这些讨论，部分是因为释放囚犯的前景。乌克兰将战俘回返作为整个冲突的核心要求。 泽连斯基在 Telegram 上写道：“对我们来说，红场并不重要，重要的是可以带回家的乌克兰战俘的生命。” 红场是俄罗斯举行传统阅兵式的地方，庆祝胜利日，这是一年中最大的节日之一。 发表声明后，泽伦斯基发布了正式的总统令“授权”……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

title.en: Pakistan: Drop in Gulf remittances puts families on edge
title.zh: 巴基斯坦：海湾地区汇款减少让家庭感到紧张

summary.en: For millions of households, money sent by Pakistani workers in the Gulf offers a lifeline, helping their families cover basic needs such as food and education.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
For millions of households, money sent by Pakistani workers in the Gulf offers a lifeline, helping their families cover basic needs such as food and education.

Samina Bibi, a 34-year-old mother of three, lives in a modest house on the outskirts of Rawalpindi, the fourth-most populous city in Pakistan. 

One early morning this week, she received a message from her husband saying that his salary would be delayed again.

Bibi's husband has been living in Saudi Arabia for the past decade. He works for a Riyadh-based construction company.

"He says the company is facing issues due to regional conflict," she said, referring to the Iran war. "I just think, what about us relying solely on his 80,000 rupees (€245, $288) per month?" 

For Samina, the delay in remittance is not merely an inconvenience, but a disruption that ripples through every part of her life. She says the Middle East crisis is directly affecting the families of migrant workers in the region.

Pakistan is among the world's largest recipients of remittances , with tens of billions of dollars flowing in each year — much of it from workers in the Gulf.

For millions of households, this money offer an economic lifeline, allowing them to cover basic needs including food, rent, education and healthcare.

According to the State Bank of Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates (UAE) contributed more than half of Pakistan's record $38.3 billion remittances in fiscal year 2025.

But as the crisis bites, causing delays and fluctuations, many are now questioning Pakistan's heavy reliance on Gulf economies.

Analysts warn that rising Middle East tensions, along with labor market shifts like increased automation and preference for hiring local workers, could threaten the remittance income for millions of Pakistani families.

"There are rising reports of workers from the Gulf being sent back. No numbers or data are available at the moment though," said Khurram Husain, an economic analyst. 

"The UAE accounts for 20% of all Pakistan remittances, so a sudden slowdown from this one source alone would create significant pressure on the reserves and families of migrant workers back home," he added.

Remittances have grown into a pillar of the national economy — supporting foreign exchange reserves and even stabilizing the currency. But that pillar rests on foundations far beyond Pakistan's borders.

"A slowdown in remittances would obviously cause a lot of difficulty — we export labor more than goods and services," Safiya Aftab, an Islamabad-based economist, told DW.

title.en: China: Calls for death penalty after teen gets life sentence
title.zh: 中国：少年被判无期徒刑后，家属呼吁判处死刑

summary.en: A 14-year-old in China's Yunnan province has been convicted of intentional homicide and rape, and sentenced to life in prison. The victim's family argue he deserves the death penalty.
summary.zh: 中国云南省一名14岁少年因故意杀人罪和强奸罪被判处无期徒刑。受害者家属呼吁判处该少年死刑。

body.en:
A 14-year-old in China's Yunnan province has been convicted of intentional homicide and rape, and sentenced to life in prison. The victim's family argue he deserves the death penalty.

In late April, an unusual court trial in China's southwestern Yunnan province led to a landmark ruling, where a local court found a minor guilty of intentional homicide and rape, and sentenced him to life imprisonment.   

At the time of the crime, the defendant was 14 years old. It marked the first time such a severe sentence was handed down to a minor in China.

The court ruled there was enough proof to support the case that, in the summer of 2025, the defendant raped his then 15-year-old classmate on her way home from a party. To prevent the crime from being discovered, he then strangled her to death.

The judges determined that the offense was particularly heinous and imposed the maximum possible sentence. The defendant is said to have confessed.

However, the victim's family considers the sentence too lenient and plans to appeal.

"We still hope for the imposition of the death penalty so that the perpetrator pays for his victim's life with his own," the victim's father told the local press, calling for "immediate execution."

Zhou Zhaocheng, the lawyer representing the victim's family, said that the demand for the death penalty "stems from their profound despair over the loss of their daughter."

From a legal standpoint, any appeal by the victim's family demanding capital punishment seems doomed to fail. Minors can neither be sentenced to death nor be given even a suspended death sentence under Chinese law. But the case has sent shock waves across China and sparked a debate on youth, crime, and consequences .

Reports on juvenile crime are rare in China. According to a report by the official Xinhua News Agency, juvenile offenders are primarily involved in sex crimes or online fraud.

In 2021, China's criminal code was amended, gradually lowering the age of criminal responsibility. Under the new code, adolescents aged 16 and older can now be held criminally responsible for breaking the law , while teenagers between the ages of 14 and 16 may be charged with various criminal offenses, including murder, rape, assault resulting in death, robbery, extortion, and drug trafficking.

"It takes into account the current situation in China, where the age of maturity for minors has generally been lowered as living standards and educational levels have risen," writes Chen Zhijun, a law professor at the People's Public Security University of China. "This allows for regional and individual disparities in the development of minors' cognitive and self-control abilities to be taken into account."

body.zh: 中国云南省一名14岁少年被判故意杀人罪和强奸罪，被判处无期徒刑。受害者的家人认为他应该被判处死刑。 4月下旬，中国西南部云南省的一次不同寻常的法庭审判得出了一项具有里程碑意义的裁决，当地法院认定一名未成年人犯有故意杀人罪和强奸罪，并判处他无期徒刑。 案发时，被告人14岁。这是中国首次对未成年人判处如此严厉的刑罚。 法院裁定，有足够证据支持该案，即2025年夏天，被告在参加聚会回家的路上强奸了当时15岁的同学。为了防止罪行被发现，他随后将她勒死。 法官认为该罪行特别令人发指，并判处了最重的刑罚。据称，被告已认罪。 但受害人家属认为量刑过轻，准备上诉。 受害者的父亲对当地媒体表示：“我们仍然希望判处死刑，以便肇事者用自己的生命来偿还受害者的生命。”他呼吁“立即处决”。 受害人家属的代理律师周兆成表示，要求死刑“源于他们对失去女儿的深切绝望”。 从法律角度来看，受害人家属要求死刑的任何上诉似乎都注定会失败。根据中国法律，未成年人不得判处死刑，甚至不得判处死刑缓期执行。但这起案件在中国引起了震动，并引发了关于青少年、犯罪及其后果的辩论。 在中国，关于青少年犯罪的报道很少见。据官方新华社报道，青少年犯罪主要涉及性犯罪或网络诈骗。 2021年，中国修改刑法，逐步降低刑事责任年龄。根据新法，16岁及以上的青少年违法行为可被追究刑事责任，而14岁至16岁的青少年可能被指控犯有各种刑事犯罪，包括谋杀、强奸、殴打致人死亡、抢劫、敲诈勒索和贩毒。 “这是考虑到中国目前的情况，随着生活水平和教育水平的提高，未成年人的成熟年龄普遍降低，”中国人民公安大学法学教授陈志军写道。 “这考虑到了未成年人认知和自我控制能力发展的地区和个人差异。” 新规定还允许对……进行刑事起诉

title.en: ASEAN leaders meet to discuss plans to ease Iran war impacts
title.zh: 东盟领导人开会讨论缓解伊朗战争影响的计划

summary.en: Southeast Asian leaders are meeting in the Philippines, with the economic fallout from the Iran war the main focus. Disputes in the South China Sea and border clashes between Thailand and Cambodia are also on the agenda.
summary.zh: 东南亚各国领导人正在菲律宾举行会议，主要关注伊朗战争造成的经济影响。南海争端以及泰国和柬埔寨之间的边境冲突也在议程上。

body.en:
Southeast Asian leaders are meeting in the Philippines, with the economic fallout from the Iran war the main focus. Disputes in the South China Sea and border clashes between Thailand and Cambodia are also on the agenda.

Leaders from Southeast Asia were meeting in the Philippines on Friday for an annual summit, which this year is focused on addressing the damaging impacts of the war in the Middle East .

The US-Israeli war with Iran and Iran's regional retaliation have caused major disruptions to energy markets and global oil supplies. Southeast Asian nations are particularly reliant on oil and LNG imports via the Strait of Hormuz , which has been blockaded by both Iran and the US for weeks .

The disruption has caused fuel and electricity prices to soar, while rising fertilizer costs are impacting food prices. Higher jet fuel costs have also made commercial air travel more expensive, reducing tourism demand in the region .

The summit is being held on the central Philippines island of Cebu. In his opening remarks, Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr., the Filipino president and the current chair of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) , said the group needed to demonstrate unity and resolve while remaining flexible to the unpredictable situation in the Middle East.

"We must ensure regional energy security and resilience," Marcos Jr. said. "At a time of heightened volatility, ​ASEAN must strengthen coordination and reinforce preparedness, pursue practical collective measures to safeguard a stable energy supply and improve ​interconnectivity."

The Philippines was one of the first countries to declare an energy emergency in the wake of the war , and is pushing for an ASEAN-wide oil-sharing pact.

In addition to emergency fuel sharing, a contingency plan outlined in a draft joint declaration calls for plans for a regional power grid, diversifying crude oil sources, boosting the use of electric vehicles and of renewables , including civilian nuclear energy .

On the eve of the leaders' summit, ASEAN economic ministers on Thursday "identified practical, concrete response measures" to guarantee energy and food security, according to a statement, without providing details on what those measures would entail.

Aside from the economic impacts of the Iran war, Southeast Asian leaders are also set to address how to evacuate their citizens from the Middle East, should hostilities in the region break out again.

Over 1 million people from Southeast Asia live and work in the Gulf, and several Southeast Asians have been killed since the US and Israel launched the war on February 28.

title.en: World Cup fans in China and India face broadcast uncertainty
title.zh: 中国和印度球迷面临世界杯转播不确定性

summary.en: Broadcasters in China and India have not yet finalized agreements with Fifa for the upcoming World Cup, leaving fans in both countries uncertain about how they will watch the tournament, which is scheduled to begin in a few weeks.
summary.zh: 距离世界杯开赛仅剩数周，中国和印度的广播公司尚未与国际足联达成协议，这使得两国球迷对如何观看比赛感到不确定。

body.en:
Millions of football fans in India and China face uncertainty over whether or not the World Cup will be shown in their countries as broadcasters have yet to reach deals with football's governing body, Fifa.

It is unusual for TV rights deals to not be agreed for an event of this scale with just weeks to go before it is due to start. Such agreements are typically settled months, if not years, before the opening ceremony.

Local media in both countries have said Fifa and broadcasters are still wrangling over the cost of showing the games.

Fifa told the the BBC that talks in China and India "are ongoing and must remain confidential at this stage", without commenting on the fees involved.

A total of 180 territories have now completed deals with Fifa, the global football organisation said.

But a handful have yet to secure the rights to broadcast the 2026 World Cup, including India and China - which together account for around a third of the world's population.

Fifa's initial offer to state broadcaster China Central Television (CCTV) for rights to the tournament was reportedly as high as $300m (£220m).

Fifa has now lowered the price to between $120m and $150m, according to state-controlled newspaper Beijing Daily. But that is still more than double CCTV's budget for the event, the paper said.

Beijing Daily said that as China has not qualified for the tournament there would be less interest in the event amongst football fans in the country.

The paper also noted that the time difference between China and North America means that many high-profile games will be played in the early hours of the morning for Chinese fans.

Fifa announced in November 2017 that it had reached an exclusive agreement with CCTV to broadcast both the 2018 and 2022 World Cups.

While an agreement has not yet been struck between Fifa and an Indian broadcaster, local media reported this week that a deal was likely to be announced soon.
body.zh: 由于转播商尚未与足球管理机构国际足联达成协议，印度和中国的数百万球迷面临着世界杯是否会在本国转播的不确定性。 对于如此规模的活动，在距离比赛开始仅几周时间的情况下，未能达成电视转播权协议的情况很不寻常。此类协议通常在开幕式前数月甚至数年达成。 两国当地媒体均表示，国际足联和转播商仍在就比赛转播费用争论不休。 国际足联告诉英国广播公司，中国和印度的谈判“正在进行中，现阶段必须保密”，但没有对所涉及的费用发表评论。 国际足联表示，目前共有 180 个地区与国际足联达成了协议。 但少数国家尚未获得 2026 年世界杯的转播权，其中包括印度和中国，这两个国家的人口合计约占世界人口的三分之一。 据报道，国际足联最初向中国中央电视台（CCTV）提出的世界杯转播权报价高达 3 亿美元（2.2 亿英镑）。 据官方报纸《北京日报》报道，国际足联现已将价格降至 1.2 亿至 1.5 亿美元之间。但该报称，这仍然是中央电视台此次活动预算的两倍多。 《北京日报》称，由于中国队没有获得参赛资格，因此国内球迷对这项赛事的兴趣会降低。 该报还指出，中国与北美的时差意味着很多备受瞩目的比赛将在凌晨为中国球迷进行。 国际足联于2017年11月宣布与中央电视台达成独家转播2018年和2022年世界杯的协议。 尽管国际足联与印度广播公司之间尚未达成协议，但当地媒体本周报道称，交易可能很快就会宣布。

reflection.en: The World Cup is a global spectacle where athletes "run in such a way as to get the prize," showcasing years of dedication and skill. For fans, the uncertainty over broadcast deals is a reminder that even the most anticipated events require careful preparation and agreement to be fully shared and celebrated.
reflection.zh: 世界杯是一场全球盛事，运动员们“奔跑以求赢得奖赏”，展现了多年的奉献和技艺。对球迷而言，转播协议的不确定性提醒我们，即使是最受期待的赛事，也需要周密的准备和协议才能被充分分享和庆祝。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Former China defence ministers convicted of corruption in latest purge of military leaders
title.zh: 中国前国防部长因腐败被定罪，军事领导层最新一轮清洗

summary.en: Two former Chinese defence ministers, Li Shangfu and Wei Fenghe, have been sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve after being convicted of bribery. These are among the most severe sentences in a years-long purge of military leaders.
summary.zh: 中国前国防部长李尚福和魏凤和因受贿罪被判处死刑，缓期两年执行。这是多年来对军事领导人进行清洗中最为严厉的判决之一。

body.en: Ex-defence ministers, Li Shangfu and Wei Fenghe both sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve, among the most severe sentences in a years-long purge Two former Chinese defence ministers were given suspended death sentences for bribery on Thursday, after being convicted by China’s military court, in some of the most severe punishments to be handed down in a years-long purge of the military. Chinese state media Xinhua announced on Thursday that Li Shangfu and Wei Fenghe were both sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve, meaning that their sentences will probably be commuted to life imprisonment if Li and Wei demonstrate good behaviour. Continue reading...
body.zh: 前国防部长李尚福和魏凤和双双被判处死刑，缓期两年执行，这是长达一年的整肃行动中最严厉的判决之一。周四，两名前中国国防部长因受贿罪被中国军事法院定罪，被判处死刑缓期执行，这是多年来军队整肃行动中最严厉的一些处罚。中国官方媒体新华社周四宣布，李尚福和魏凤和双双被判处死刑，缓期两年执行，这意味着如果李尚福和魏凤和表现良好，他们的刑期可能会被减为无期徒刑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of former defence ministers for bribery highlights the destructive power of greed, which can lead even those in high office to severe consequences. This serves as a sober reminder that the pursuit of wealth above all else often results in profound personal and public grief.
reflection.zh: 前国防部长因受贿被定罪，凸显了贪婪的破坏力，即使身居高位者也可能因此面临严峻后果。这提醒我们，将财富置于一切之上，往往会带来深刻的个人和公共悲痛。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Crowds cheer China's new snooker star on return from championship win
title.zh: 人群欢呼中国斯诺克新星夺冠归来

summary.en: Wu Yize, 22, received a rock star's welcome upon his return to China after becoming the second-youngest player to win a world snooker title.
summary.zh: 22岁的吴宜泽在赢得世界斯诺克冠军后回到中国，受到了摇滚明星般的欢迎，成为史上第二年轻的世界冠军。

body.en:
Loud chanting and cheering rang around the room in the western Chinese city of Xi'an.

He waved modestly, wearing the expression of a shy 22-year-old not used to such sudden fame at home.

But that did not dampen the enthusiasm of those who had come to get a glimpse of someone on top of the world.

Earlier this week, a Chinese player won the World Snooker championship for the second year in a row, and it has captivated this country.

It is not only the repeat success driving this. It is also the fairytale story of a young man who dropped out of school aged 16 to move to Sheffield, England, in pursuit of a dream to turn professional.

He has now returned home as the second-youngest player ever to be crowned world champion.

The BBC asked Wu what he thought of so many fans turning out to see him. He replied with a gentle smile: "It's great to feel the warmth of my homeland."

The baby-faced snooker magician showed off some shots to the ooh-ing and ah-ing audience, including when he played one fan, Liu Yi fei. She had won an earlier play-off here to have a hit with him.

She said Wu's success had made her more determined to improve her own skills, and that this country expected to see plenty more like him in the future.

"In China, so many more people are playing," she said. "More pool halls are opening, and the sport is becoming ever more popular."

It is estimated that some 60 million people play billiards in China every year, in around 300,000 halls like the one in Xi'an.

The country is now churning out high-quality snooker competitors. They currently make up a quarter of all players on the professional circuit.

One eight-year-old boy told the BBC he was already pretty good himself: "One day, I'd like to be champion like Wu Yize."

One reason for China's snooker explosion is that it remains relatively cheap to play here.

It is a bonus for a sport in a city like Xi'an, which - like all of western China - has not enjoyed the same level of booming economic development as that in the country's south-east.

Even further to the west, Wu's home province of Gansu - known for its deserts - is less privileged again.

That he hails from such a region has fuelled the rags to riches aspect of his story.

Tales of him sharing a bed with his father in a flat with no windows as a teenager in Sheffield have made his victory seem sweeter, especially after he declared he would spend his prize money on a place for his parents to stay in England so they could support him.

Another fan, who came from Wu's home province and took hours to reach Xi'an via high-speed train, brought along a photo of the champion to get it signed.
body.zh: 在中国西部城市西安，房间里响起了大声的口号和欢呼声。 他谦虚地挥手，脸上的表情就像一个害羞的22岁年轻人，不习惯在家里突然出名。 但这并没有浇灭那些前来一睹世界之巅风采的人们的热情。 本周早些时候，中国选手连续第二年夺得斯诺克世界冠军，这让这个国家着迷。 这不仅仅是重复的成功推动的。这也是一个童话故事，讲述了一个16岁的年轻人为了追求成为职业球员的梦想而辍学搬到英国谢菲尔德的故事。 现在，他作为有史以来第二年轻的获得世界冠军的球员回到了家乡。 BBC询问吴对于这么多粉丝前来观看他有何看法。他温柔地笑着回答：“感受到家乡的温暖真是太好了。” 这位娃娃脸的斯诺克魔术师向现场观众展示了一些镜头，其中包括他扮演一位球迷刘亦菲的镜头。她早些时候在这里赢得了一场附加赛，与他一击。 她说，吴的成功让她更加坚定了提高自己技能的决心，并且这个国家希望未来能看到更多像他这样的人。 “在中国，有更多的人在玩，”她说。 “更多的台球馆正在开放，这项运动也变得越来越受欢迎。” 据估计，中国每年约有6000万人打台球，像西安这样的球馆约有30万个。 中国现在正在培养高素质的斯诺克选手。目前，他们占职业巡回赛所有球员的四分之一。 一名八岁男孩告诉BBC，他自己已经很不错了：“有一天，我想成为像吴宜泽一样的冠军。” 中国斯诺克运动蓬勃发展的原因之一是在这里打球的成本相对较低。 对于西安这样的城市来说，这是一项体育运动的福音，因为西安和中国西部地区一样，经济发展水平不及中国东南部地区。 再往西，吴的故乡甘肃省——以沙漠而闻名——的地位又不那么优越了。 他来自这样一个地区，这也助长了他白手起家的故事。 十几岁的时候，他在谢菲尔德与父亲在一套没有窗户的公寓里同住一张床的故事让他的胜利显得更加甜蜜，尤其是在他宣布将用奖金为父母在英格兰买一个住所，以便他们可以养活他之后。 另一位来自吴家乡的球迷，乘坐高铁花了几个小时才到达西安，他带来了一张冠军的照片来签名。

reflection.en: The enthusiastic welcome for Wu Yize highlights the immense pressure and scrutiny that often accompany public acclaim. Proverbs reminds us that just as precious metals are refined by fire, a person's character is truly tested by the praise and adulation they receive. May he navigate this new level of fame with grace and humility.
reflection.zh: 吴宜泽所受到的热烈欢迎，凸显了公众赞誉常伴随的巨大压力和审视。箴言提醒我们，正如贵金属在炉火中得以精炼，一个人的品格也通过他所获得的赞美和崇拜而受到真正的考验。愿他能以恩典和谦逊来应对这新的名声。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Two men first in British history to be found guilty of spying for China
title.zh: 两名男子在英国历史上首次被判为中国从事间谍活动罪名成立

summary.en: Two men, a UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official, have been found guilty in British history of spying for China. They were convicted for their involvement in a 'shadow policing' operation that surveilled dissidents in the UK.
summary.zh: 两名男子，一名英国边境部队官员和一名香港贸易官员，因替中国从事间谍活动并监视异议人士的“影子警务”行动，在英国历史上首次被判有罪。

body.en: Chi Leung Wai and Chung Biu Yuen convicted over surveillance of dissidents in ‘shadow policing’ operation A UK Border Force officer and Hong Kong trade official based in London have been found guilty of spying for China and surveilling dissidents through a “shadow policing” operation. Chi Leung “Peter” Wai, 38, and Chung Biu Yuen, 65, also known as Bill, were found guilty at the Old Bailey of assisting a foreign intelligence service, making them the first people in British history to be convicted of spying for China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 池良伟和钟标源因在“影子警务”行动中监视异见人士而被定罪 英国边境部队一名官员和驻伦敦的香港贸易官员被判犯有为中国从事间谍活动并通过“影子警务”行动监视异见人士的罪名。 38 岁的 Chi Leung “Peter” Wai 和 65 岁的 Chung Biu Yuen（又名 Bill）在老贝利被判犯有协助外国情报机构罪，这使他们成为英国历史上第一批因为中国从事间谍活动而被定罪的人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the profound impact of governance on people's lives, particularly when state power is used to suppress dissent beyond its borders. The conviction of these individuals underscores the importance of accountability when authority is misused, reminding us that true leadership serves the well-being of all.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了治理对人们生活产生的深远影响，尤其当国家权力被用于在其境外压制异议时。这些涉案人员被定罪，强调了权力被滥用时问责制的重要性，提醒我们真正的领导力在于服务所有人的福祉。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: ‘They have built a machine that pulls out their mother tongue’: why Tibet’s children ‘think they are Chinese’
title.zh: “他们建造了一台机器，拔掉了他们的母语”：为什么藏族儿童“认为自己是中国人”

summary.en: Tibetan parents express concern that mandatory Mandarin instruction in schools is causing their children to lose their mother tongue and cultural identity from an early age. One mother reported her five-year-old stopped speaking Tibetan completely weeks after starting preschool.
summary.zh: 藏族家长表示，学校强制推行普通话教学，导致他们的孩子从小就失去母语和文化认同。一位母亲称，她五岁的孩子在入读幼儿园几周后，就完全停止说藏语了。

body.en: Parents say the insistence on Mandarin in schools is eroding the Tibetan language and culture right from early childhood Weeks after a Tibetan-speaking five-year-old started preschool, she had “completely stopped speaking Tibetan”, according to her mother. Nine months later, although the child could still understand Tibetan, she only answered in Mandarin, and at best a few single-word answers in Tibetan after some time. Instead the girl “keeps saying that she can only speak Chinese … that she is Chinese and not Tibetan”, according to a researcher who met the family. “The mother thinks that the daughter is just repeating what she is constantly told at school and that the government aims to eradicate Tibetan.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 家长们表示，学校坚持讲普通话正在侵蚀藏族语言和文化，据她的母亲说，一名说藏语的五岁孩子进入学前班几周后，她就“完全不再说藏语了”。九个月过去了，虽然孩子还能听懂藏语，但她只用普通话回答，一段时间后最多只能用藏语回答几个字。相反，据一位见过这家人的研究人员称，这名女孩“一直说她只会说中文……她是中国人，不是藏人”。 “母亲认为女儿只是在重复她在学校经常被告知的事情，政府的目标是消灭藏人。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights the profound challenge parents face when their children's cultural and linguistic heritage is threatened by external pressures. Deuteronomy 6:6-7 reminds us of the sacred task of passing on our deepest values and identity to the next generation, diligently teaching them in every aspect of life. This calls for wisdom and perseverance in...
reflection.zh: 这个故事凸显了当孩子的文化和语言遗产受到外部压力威胁时，父母所面临的深刻挑战。申命记6:6-7提醒我们，将我们最深刻的价值观和身份认同传承给下一代，在生活的各个方面殷勤教导他们，是一项神圣的任务。这要求我们在培养每个孩子独特遗产方面，拥有智慧和毅力。

verse.textEn: These commandments that I give you today are to be on your hearts. Impress them on your children. Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
verse.textZh: 我今日所吩咐你的话都要记在心上，也要殷勤教训你的儿女。无论你坐在家里，行在路上，躺下，起来，都要谈论。

title.en: No cults, no politics, no ghouls: how China censors the video game world – podcast
title.zh: 无邪教、无政治、无鬼怪：中国如何审查视频游戏世界——播客

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai honored by DW
title.zh: 香港民主派出版人黎智英获德国之声表彰

summary.en: Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Before being imprisoned for 20 years, Jimmy Lai founded Hong Kong's largest pro-democracy newspaper. His son said the award shows that those who fight for the freedom of others "are never alone."

Arriving in Hong Kong as a penniless 12-year-old stowaway from southern China, Jimmy Lai sought only freedom and a future. At the time, Lai could never have imagined how his life would become forever intertwined with this former British colony.

"I'll sink with the ship, because this place gives me everything," said Lai in an interview about Hong Kong with DW a few months before he was taken into custody in December 2020. He was one of the first high-profile figures to be targeted under a "national security law" imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing following a crackdown on pro-democracy protests.

Beijing had said the law would restore Hong Kong "from chaos to order" after demonstrations in 2019 opposing an extradition bill morphed into massive protests against Beijing encroaching on Hong Kong's civil liberties .

Since then, the pro-democracy media mogul has spent nearly 2,000 days in solitary confinement in Hong Kong's maximum-security Stanley Prison.

Lai's years-long trial ended this February, when the 78-year-old was sentenced to 20 years in prison for "colluding with foreign forces." While he had pleaded not guilty to all charges, his legal team said he will not appeal.

The sentence is the heaviest punishment handed down so far under the national security law, and Lai's trial has symbolized for many people the severe erosion of press freedom in Hong Kong as part of Beijing's broader strategy to silence critical voices.

In recognition of his defense of press freedom and freedom of speech, DW has awarded Jimmy Lai with this year's Freedom of Speech Award.

Since 2015, the DW Freedom of Speech Award has honored journalists and human rights defenders as a way to call attention to restrictions on press freedom and concerning human rights situations around the world.

Sebastien Lai, Jimmy Lai's son and a longtime advocate for his release, told DW that "people who fight for freedom, people who fight for the freedom of others are never alone." And it's meaningful at a time when "a lot of media in Hong Kong now are self-censoring."

"I think if he knew about it [the award], he'd be very happy," Sebastien Lai said.             

DW Director General Barbara Massing said that with the award, DW is honoring Jimmy Lai's "indispensable dedication to democratic values."

body.en:
One Nation's David Farley campaigned on water security, regional cost-of-living pressures and anti-establishment politics. Source: AAP / Bianca de Marchi

One Nation is set to win its first-ever federal lower house seat at the ballot box, with David Farley projected by the ABC to win a by-election in the regional NSW seat of Farrer.

The ABC declared Farley the projected winner at around 8pm in the closely watched race, which is seen as having broader implications for conservative politics across the country.

As of 9pm, with ballot papers from 82 of 94 polling places returned, the Australian Electoral Commission (AEC) was reporting a 34.76 swing towards One Nation.

It was a shift that came at the expense of the Liberal Party, which experienced an almost equally large decline in support, with the AEC reporting a 31.23 swing against the party that has held the seat since 2001.

Both Farley and the Climate-200-funded independent candidate, Michelle Milthorpe, were polling far above the Liberal and National Party candidates.

By 8:30, both Milthorpe and Liberal candidate Raissa Butkowski had conceded to Farley. Shortly after, outgoing Farrer MP and former Opposition leader Sussan Ley sent out a message congratulating Farley and One Nation on their victory.

"Serving the people of Farrer for 25 years, having been endorsed by locals at nine elections, was the privilege of my professional life. I know David will feel the same sense of honour and responsibility," she said.

Ley, who announced her resignation from parliament after losing a leadership contest to Angus Taylor in February, had represented the electorate for 25 years. It has been held by either Liberal or National party MPs since it was created in 1949.

But this election was different. Milthorpe and Farley were the front-runners, with Farley tipped to take the seat thanks to the Coalition preferencing him on their how-to-vote cards.

The race has garnered national attention, with analysts viewing it as a test of whether One Nation could convert its year-long surge in the polls to electoral success and win its first seat in the lower house since the party's founding.

While party leader Pauline Hanson was an MP in the lower house when she founded the populist party in 1997, she was voted in as an independent after the Liberal Party disendorsed her as a candidate.

Likewise, the party's only other lower house presence since its founding, Barnaby Joyce, wasn't elected as a One Nation MP. He joined the party after defecting from the Nationals late last year.

"The nation's looking for change, and Farrer's screaming out for change, so today is very, very important," Farley had told reporters ahead of the result.

title.en: How do Australians really feel about each other? New data paints an 'alarming' picture
title.zh: 澳大利亚人彼此之间的真实感受如何？新数据描绘了一幅“令人震惊”的画面

summary.en: Widespread declines were observed in a survey exploring how much Australians trust each other and the country's institutions.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
New findings indicate that Australians are feeling let down by the country's governments. Source: AAP / George Chan

Australians are less trusting of each other than they were five years ago, according to new data that also reveals shifting attitudes towards cultural diversity.

Residents aged 15 and over across 13,302 households were polled for the Australian Bureau of Statistics' (ABS) 2025 General Social Survey, which also found that almost one in 10 Australians are reporting "very high mental distress".

The survey results, collected between May and June of last year, showed declines in many areas of Australian life.

In 2025, Australians feel less healthy, less satisfied, less open and more stressed than they did five years earlier, according to the survey.

The greatest drop in overall life satisfaction was recorded in people aged 25-34.

Young women aged 15-24 recorded the highest rates of mental distress (17 per cent).

Dr Kate Lycett from Deakin University said while many of these results were "alarming", she was thrilled to see the government investing in this kind of data collection because it gave a much fuller view of society than GDP, hospital admissions data, or the unemployment rate.

"If we don't invest in tracking it, we don't know how people are feeling about their lives, which is what really matters," she said.

Very high levels of mental distress were also recorded in people with a mental health condition (31 per cent), people with a disability (18 per cent) and people who identified as gay, lesbian and bisexual (18 per cent).

Only half of Australians feel like most people can be trusted, down from 61 per cent in 2020.

The greatest drop-off was seen in Australians' trust in the country's healthcare system, but people have also lost trust in the police and justice system.

"Healthcare is a public good, but right now people can't access it, or can't access it equally, because it has been privatised."

She said these findings indicated that people are feeling let down by governments.

"The things that we invest in our choices, and the data is showing us where people want investment," she said.

"There's no reason why we can't be investing more in hospitals. You know, these are choices that we're making."

The findings follow a report last year that found national belonging had slumped to its lowest levels since 2007 , driven by a widening gap in life satisfaction between younger and older people.

While it is still generally accepted that multiculturalism is good for society — 75 per cent of people agree — that number has declined by 10 per cent since 2020.

body.zh: 新的调查结果表明，澳大利亚人对该国政府感到失望。资料来源：AAP / 陈乔治 新数据显示，与五年前相比，澳大利亚人彼此之间的信任度有所下降，这也揭示了人们对文化多样性态度的转变。 澳大利亚统计局 (ABS) 2025 年综合社会调查对 13,302 个家庭中 15 岁及以上的居民进行了民意调查，该调查还发现，近十分之一的澳大利亚人报告“精神困扰非常严重”。 去年五月至六月期间收集的调查结果显示，澳大利亚生活的许多领域都在下降。 调查显示，到 2025 年，澳大利亚人会比五年前感觉更不健康、更不满足、更不开放、压力更大。 25-34 岁人群总体生活满意度下降幅度最大。 15-24 岁的年轻女性遭受精神困扰的比例最高（17%）。 迪肯大学的凯特·莱塞特博士表示，虽然其中许多结果“令人震惊”，但她很高兴看到政府投资于此类数据收集，因为它比国内生产总值、入院数据或失业率更全面地反映了社会。 “如果我们不投资追踪它，我们就不知道人们对自己的生活有何感受，而这才是真正重要的，”她说。 有精神健康问题的人（31%）、残疾人（18%）以及同性恋和双性恋者（18%）的精神困扰程度也非常高。 只有一半的澳大利亚人认为大多数人是值得信任的，低于 2020 年的 61%。 澳大利亚人对该国医疗保健系统的信任度下降幅度最大，但人们也对警察和司法系统失去了信任。 “医疗保健是一项公共物品，但现在人们无法获得它，或者无法平等地获得它，因为它已经被私有化。” 她说这些调查结果表明人们对政府感到失望。 “我们选择投资的东西，数据向我们展示了人们想要投资的地方，”她说。 “我们没有理由不能对医院进行更多投资。你知道，这些是我们正在做出的选择。” 去年的一份报告发现，由于年轻人和老年人之间的生活满意度差距不断扩大，国家归属感已降至 2007 年以来的最低水平。 虽然人们仍然普遍认为多元文化主义对社会有益——75%的人同意这一点——但这一数字自 2020 年以来已经下降了 10%。 79% 的女性同意这一说法，而男性的这一比例为 73%。 居住在城市的人们也更有可能同意这一点……

title.en: Taylor vows to fight until polls close in Farrer as One Nation eyes historic win

summary.en: A by-election is underway in the Farrer electorate, a traditionally conservative seat. The incumbent, Taylor, has pledged to continue campaigning until the polls close, as Pauline Hanson's One Nation party aims for a significant victory, marking this election as a key test for the party.

body.en:
Opposition leader Angus Taylor (left) campaigned with Liberal candidate for Farrer Raissa Butkowski (right) in Albury on Saturday. Source: AAP / Bianca De Marchi

The federal Opposition has vowed to campaign until the final ballot is cast in a by-election that could cost the Liberal Party a seat it has held for a quarter of a century.

Opposition leader Angus Taylor was alongside candidate Raissa Butkowski as she cast her vote in Lavington, north of Albury, in NSW on Saturday.

"I'm going to be fighting till six o'clock tonight to make sure we do [win] and that's my focus today," Taylor told reporters.

"Working with Raissa, we're going to be talking to the people of Farrer and making sure they understand our commitment to the important issues in this area."

The race for Farrer in southern NSW is being viewed as an electoral test of support for Pauline Hanson's populist One Nation party, which could win its first lower-house seat.

The electorate has been held by either the Liberal or National party since its inception in 1949, and was held by recent Opposition leader Sussan Ley from 2001 until she was ousted by Taylor in a February leadership spill.

Butkowski thanked Ley for her 25 years of serving the people of Farrer and said the former leader had contacted her following her pre-selection.

"It's really important the people of Farrer have somebody who's going to fight, not only for now, but far into the future," Butkowski said.

One Nation candidate and polling front-runner David Farley was mobbed by a press pack entering Albury Public School shortly after voting began at 8am.

If he wins, a historic first lower house federal seat for Pauline Hanson's party could spell trouble for the Coalition as it continues to lose votes to the alternative conservative party.

"The nation's looking for change and Farrer's screaming out for change, so today is very, very important," Farley told reporters.

"I've got three clear jobs to do: I've got to win today, I've got to make sure we're ready for the next election and I want to help Pauline Hanson and her team build a powerful political party for Australia."

He and independent Michelle Milthorpe appear neck and neck to take the seat but analysts believe preferences could get One Nation over the line, while Coalition candidates struggle.

Attending a voting centre in Jindera, Milthorpe rejected criticism from opponents over funding received from Climate 200.

"It's just lazy rhetoric by parties who are scared and threatened by people who want to do things differently," she told reporters.

"I'm open and transparent about where mine comes from and my positions are informed by the people of Farrer."

Milthorpe said politicians didn't need to be negative or aggressive to get things done.
